blurb: `expect` is a test claim, checked when a `case` runs. Production code has no test runner to report a failure to, so an `expect` in a function, a handler or anywhere else outside a `case` body is refused. To check a condition in running code, return a `Bool` or a `Result`; to check it in a test, move the `expect` into a case. A `requires` or `ensures` contract is the always-on form.
